nodes.rationale: Query the graph before grepping or reading source files because it returns a scoped subgraph in far fewer tokens; graph.json is rewritten whole on every build, so large diffs to it are expected.

nodes.label: Known gaps (rate limiting, failed refunds only flagged, no completed/no_show, no tariffs)
nodes.norm_label: known gaps (rate limiting, failed refunds only flagged, no completed/no_show, no tariffs)

nodes.label: Mobile layout (app, api, auth, lib, i18n, ui)
nodes.norm_label: mobile layout (app, api, auth, lib, i18n, ui)

nodes.label: Roadmap (4 phases: backend core, mobile app, admin + real integrations, Windows client)
nodes.norm_label: roadmap (4 phases: backend core, mobile app, admin + real integrations, windows client)

nodes.label: Expo commands (expo install/start/lint, tsc --noEmit, expo-doctor)
nodes.rationale: Lint and typecheck must be run before declaring any task done.

nodes.label: Mobile app quick start (npm run web, Expo Go, EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL on LAN)
nodes.norm_label: mobile app quick start (npm run web, expo go, expo_public_api_url on lan)

nodes.label: adult_from() - adulthood starts 00:00 club-local on the 18th birthday
nodes.norm_label: adult_from() - adulthood starts 00:00 club-local on the 18th birthday
nodes.rationale: This is the only place that encodes the adulthood interpretation (29 Feb birthdays become 1 Mar).

nodes.label: Age rule: under-18 cannot book or play during [22:00, 06:00) club-local
nodes.norm_label: age rule: under-18 cannot book or play during [22:00, 06:00) club-local
nodes.rationale: Half-open window (ending at 22:00 and starting at 06:00 are allowed); a booking is rejected if any instant is both at night and before adulthood; age is known only for identity-verified users, so unverified users cannot book at all.

nodes.label: AppError and error envelope {error: {code, message, details}}
nodes.norm_label: apperror and error envelope {error: {code, message, details}}
nodes.rationale: Clients localize by error code (ru/kk/en), so codes are API contract: new ones may be added freely but existing ones are never renamed.

nodes.label: Booking lifecycle (pending_payment -> confirmed -> completed / cancelled / expired)
nodes.norm_label: booking lifecycle (pending_payment -> confirmed -> completed / cancelled / expired)
nodes.rationale: A booking holds its slot for 10 minutes while pending payment; payment within the hold confirms it, cancel before start refunds it, and an unpaid hold expires.

nodes.label: Times shown and picked on the club's clock, never the phone's
nodes.norm_label: times shown and picked on the club's clock, never the phone's
nodes.rationale: Booking slots and opening hours are defined in club-local time, so the phone's timezone must not influence what the customer sees or picks (lib/time.ts).

nodes.label: Configuration from environment / backend/.env (ENVIRONMENT=prod guard)
nodes.rationale: ENVIRONMENT=prod refuses to start with dev secrets or a fixed OTP code, so development shortcuts cannot leak into production.

nodes.label: CORS policy (localhost in dev, CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN_REGEX otherwise)
nodes.norm_label: cors policy (localhost in dev, cors_allow_origin_regex otherwise)
nodes.rationale: CORS exists only for browser clients (Expo web preview, later the admin panel); nothing is allowed in test/prod unless explicitly configured.

nodes.label: Enums: StrEnum in code, VARCHAR + CHECK in the database
nodes.norm_label: enums: strenum in code, varchar + check in the database
nodes.rationale: No PostgreSQL enum types are used; values are constrained with CHECK constraints instead.

nodes.label: Double booking prevented by PostgreSQL exclusion constraints (migration 0002, btree_gist)
nodes.norm_label: double booking prevented by postgresql exclusion constraints (migration 0002, btree_gist)
nodes.rationale: The database guarantees no overlapping active bookings per PC or per user; the service only maps the violation to SLOT_TAKEN / USER_BOOKING_OVERLAP. A check-then-insert in Python must not replace it because it would be racy.

nodes.label: Idempotency-Key per payment attempt (reused on retry)
nodes.norm_label: idempotency-key per payment attempt (reused on retry)
nodes.rationale: Paying requires an Idempotency-Key header and replays return the original payment, so a retried request cannot create a second payment.

nodes.label: IIN rule (12 digits, century/sex digit, two-pass mod 11 check digit)
nodes.norm_label: iin rule (12 digits, century/sex digit, two-pass mod 11 check digit)
nodes.rationale: Local parsing (domain/iin.py) is only a filter; the birth date returned by the IdentityVerifier is authoritative and must match the IIN.

nodes.label: Integrations behind typing.Protocol with mocks, wired in registry.py
nodes.norm_label: integrations behind typing.protocol with mocks, wired in registry.py
nodes.rationale: External systems (eGov IIN lookup, card acquirer, Kaspi, SMS) are Protocols so a real adapter is one new file plus one registry line and services never change; selection is by settings (IDENTITY_PROVIDER, PAYMENT_PROVIDER_CARD, PAYMENT_PROVIDER_KASPI, SMS_PROVIDER).

nodes.label: Layering: router -> service -> domain (pure domain, services commit)
nodes.norm_label: layering: router -> service -> domain (pure domain, services commit)
nodes.rationale: Routers only parse input and shape output, services own the use-case and the transaction, and domain/ has no I/O at all so business rules stay pure and unit-testable.

nodes.label: Lazy expiry of unpaid holds (on create/list/get/pay)
nodes.norm_label: lazy expiry of unpaid holds (on create/list/get/pay)
nodes.rationale: There is no background worker yet, so holds are expired on access and availability queries ignore expired holds.

nodes.label: Money as whole tenge int with _kzt suffix
nodes.norm_label: money as whole tenge int with _kzt suffix
nodes.rationale: Whole tenge as int avoids rounding issues: no floats, no Decimal.

nodes.label: Multi-tenancy: organizations -> clubs -> zones -> pcs (staff scoped to one organization)
nodes.norm_label: multi-tenancy: organizations -> clubs -> zones -> pcs (staff scoped to one organization)
nodes.rationale: Every admin query filters by staff.organization_id and answers 404 (not 403) for other organizations' data so existence is not revealed; customers are global.

nodes.label: OpenAPI type generation (mobile/openapi.json -> src/api/schema.d.ts)
nodes.rationale: The mobile app's API types are generated from a dump of the backend's OpenAPI spec, so the dump must be refreshed after API changes before running npm run gen:api.

nodes.label: Booking shown as paid only after re-reading it from the server
nodes.norm_label: booking shown as paid only after re-reading it from the server
nodes.rationale: Payment confirmation happens only via provider webhook on the server; the mock payment buttons merely make the mock provider send its webhook.

nodes.label: PII: IIN encrypted (Fernet) + HMAC, masked, never logged
nodes.norm_label: pii: iin encrypted (fernet) + hmac, masked, never logged
nodes.rationale: The HMAC provides uniqueness without decrypting; Kazakhstan law requires storing citizens' personal data on servers inside Kazakhstan, which constrains production hosting.

nodes.label: Rotating refresh token (replay revokes all sessions)
nodes.norm_label: rotating refresh token (replay revokes all sessions)
nodes.rationale: Replaying an already rotated refresh token is treated as token theft, so all sessions are revoked.

nodes.label: requires_overlap_constraints test marker (needs real PostgreSQL with btree_gist)
nodes.norm_label: requires_overlap_constraints test marker (needs real postgresql with btree_gist)
nodes.rationale: The optional embedded server lacks btree_gist, so these tests are skipped there; a green run with skips does not prove overlap protection.

nodes.label: Row-lock order: booking, then payment
nodes.rationale: A fixed lock order across booking and payment services avoids deadlocks.

nodes.label: App never decides business rules (shows server error by code)
nodes.norm_label: app never decides business rules (shows server error by code)
nodes.rationale: The server is the single authority for business rules; local IIN/phone/slot checks only catch typos and draw the picker.

nodes.label: Single-flight token refresh (api/client.ts)
nodes.rationale: Replaying a rotated refresh token revokes all sessions, so concurrent 401s must share one refresh call.

nodes.label: Testing rules (domain unit tests, real PostgreSQL through the API)
nodes.norm_label: testing rules (domain unit tests, real postgresql through the api)
nodes.rationale: Every domain rule change needs unit tests including boundaries; database-dependent behaviour is tested against real PostgreSQL, never SQLite or a mocked session; each integration test runs in a rolled-back transaction.

nodes.label: Time rule: timestamptz UTC, club IANA timezone, injected Clock
nodes.norm_label: time rule: timestamptz utc, club iana timezone, injected clock
nodes.rationale: Time of day is evaluated in club-local time (default Asia/Almaty); datetime.now() is forbidden in application code so tests can control time; naive datetimes are rejected at the API.

nodes.label: UUIDv7 IDs generated in the app (double as pagination cursors)
nodes.norm_label: uuidv7 ids generated in the app (double as pagination cursors)
nodes.rationale: UUIDv7 values are time-ordered, so they can be used as pagination cursors.

nodes.label: Booking confirmed only by a verified provider webhook
nodes.norm_label: booking confirmed only by a verified provider webhook
nodes.rationale: A client call can never confirm a booking; only a verified webhook from the payment provider is trusted.

nodes.label: Continuous Native Generation (never hand-edit ios/ and android/)
nodes.norm_label: continuous native generation (never hand-edit ios/ and android/)
nodes.rationale: The native directories are generated, so native behavior is configured in app.json and config plugins rather than edited by hand.

nodes.label: Development build required for libraries with native code (Expo Go limits)
nodes.norm_label: development build required for libraries with native code (expo go limits)
nodes.rationale: Expo Go only includes its bundled native modules, so adding a library with native code needs expo run:ios|android or eas build --profile development.

nodes.label: npx expo install (always instead of npm/yarn/pnpm/bun add)
nodes.norm_label: npx expo install (always instead of npm/yarn/pnpm/bun add)
nodes.rationale: expo install resolves SDK-compatible package versions, which a plain package-manager add does not.

nodes.label: Expo Router navigation (routes in src/app, _layout.tsx navigators)
nodes.norm_label: expo router navigation (routes in src/app, _layout.tsx navigators)
nodes.rationale: Every file in src/app is a screen, so non-route code (components, hooks, utils) must live outside src/app.

nodes.label: Expo has changed - check versioned docs, do not trust training data
nodes.norm_label: expo has changed - check versioned docs, do not trust training data
nodes.rationale: Expo ships breaking changes every SDK release, so remembered APIs are likely renamed, moved or removed; read the expo major version in package.json and fetch the matching versioned docs or llms.txt instead of answering from memory.

nodes.label: Prefer recommended Expo modules over third-party libraries
nodes.norm_label: prefer recommended expo modules over third-party libraries

nodes.label: Embedded PostgreSQL fallback for integration tests (no btree_gist)
nodes.norm_label: embedded postgresql fallback for integration tests (no btree_gist)
nodes.rationale: Without TEST_DATABASE_URL the integration tests can use an embedded PostgreSQL, but the double-booking tests are skipped there because that server has no btree_gist extension.

nodes.norm_label: android adaptive icon background layer (light-blue construction-guide grid: concentric circles, dashed centre line and diagonals)
